# Exemplar Polarity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ExemplarPolarity`](gmeow-ExemplarPolarity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ExemplarPolarity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The direction of an exemplar — a CLOSED three-member value vocabulary: positive (emulate this), negative (avoid this), cautionary (a boundary case that LOOKS positive but redirects or warns). Closed because the trichotomy is the design: finer judgement nuance belongs in the rationale and the anchored range, not in new polarities.

Use [`gmeow:ExemplarPolarity`](gmeow-ExemplarPolarity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
